question: For an ECM-based scaffold intended to bridge a dermal defect, does scaffold degradation rate outpace host collagen deposition, and does that drive myofibroblast conversion?
goal: Choose the smallest cell-level experiment set that separates the plausible explanations before any animal work.
constraints: single cell type only, for cost and time

evidence.statement: Scaffold mass loss reached 60% by day 14 in our hands
evidence.measurement_context: gravimetric, n=3, one scaffold lot, not blinded

evidence.statement: alpha-SMA positive cells increased between day 7 and day 14
evidence.measurement_context: immunofluorescence, n=2, scored by one operator
